notes.title: 2024-06-27 Update - Version 1.2.0 and new DLC!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, we'd like to share update 1.2.0 for [i]CRYMACHINA[/i] with the following bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed the new Head and Waist Personality Enhancement Gears displaying incorrect icons under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed Archive entry for Server Farm Patience having an incorrect network listed.
[*] Fixed Frontier Fort: Extreme stage keeping the New label even after clearing it.
[/list]
Please report issues you may have to the Steam troubleshooting forum.


Additionally, the following two new DLCs are now available.
[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2940390/CRYMACHINA__Standard_Uniform_Set]CRYMACHINA - Standard Uniform Set[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2940400/CRYMACHINA__Trinity_Set_Three_additional_playable_characters]CRYMACHINA - Trinity Set (Three additional playable characters)[/url]
[/list]
Customers who already own other DLCs can save by purchasing one of the following two bundles to complete the contents.
[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42825/CRYMACHINA__Complete_Costumes_June_2024_Update]CRYMACHINA - Complete Costumes (June 2024 Update)[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42826/CRYMACHINA_Ultimate_Edition_June_2024_Update]CRYMACHINA Ultimate Edition (June 2024 Update)[/url]
[/list]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: 2023-11-18 Update - Version 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[list]
[*] New items added.
[*] Stability and minor bug fixes.
[*] Minor text fixes.
[*] [b]PC specific:[/b] Fixed issue that prevented players from selecting Auxiliaries to dismantle when using the keyboard.
